title: Axon Hub | Auto Farm, Auto Raid, Auto Mastery & Race V4
features:
Axon Hub brings Auto Farm, Auto Quest, Auto Raid, Auto Mastery and Fruit ESP to Blox Fruits, with features for First, Second and Third Sea progression.

Auto Level Farming has been fixed in the latest update!

⚔️ AUTO FARM & LEVELING
• Auto Level Farm with automatic quest selection.
• Choose your quest priority and farming weapon.
• Auto Farm Nearest enemies.
• Auto Boss Farm with boss selection and optional server hopping.
• Auto Material Farm for your selected resources.
• Auto Stats to distribute available points.

🔥 MASTERY & FIGHTING STYLES
• Auto Mastery with configurable finishing skills.
• Auto Fighting Styles, including Godhuman and Sanguine Art.
• Automatic sea travel for supported fighting-style progression.
• Auto Buso Haki and Observation training.
• Auto Observation V2 and Rainbow Haki.

🏝️ RAIDS & AWAKENING
• Auto Start and Auto Clear Raids.
• Auto Awaken your fruit when requirements are met.
• Raid chip selection and purchase options.
• Dough and Phoenix Raid unlock automation.
• Auto Factory Raid or Pirate Raid, depending on your sea.

🍎 FRUITS & ESP
• Auto Collect and Auto Store Fruits.
• Auto Random Fruit.
• Regular and Mirage fruit dealer purchase options.
• Fruit ESP alongside players, chests, berries and islands.
• Customizable ESP names, distance and health displays.

💀 BOSSES, ITEMS & UPGRADES
• Auto Bones and Soul Reaper.
• Auto Cake Prince and Dough King.
• Auto Elite Hunter and rip_indra.
• Auto CDK progression.
• Auto Weapon Upgrades with optional missing-material farming.
• Auto Chest and Berry collection.

🌊 SEA EVENTS & ISLANDS
• Auto Sea Events with selectable targets.
• Sea Beast, Terrorshark and other sea-event options.
• Auto Sail with boat and destination selection.
• Search for Mirage, Kitsune and Prehistoric Islands.
• Auto Kitsune Event and Volcano Event.
• Auto Dragon Eggs and Dino Bones.

🧬 RACE PROGRESSION
• Auto Race V2 and V3.
• Race V4 tools for Blue Gear, trials and training.
• Auto Dojo Belts and Dragon Hunter.
• Auto Draco V1–V3 and Draco Trial options.

⚙️ EXTRA TOOLS
• Island and NPC travel.
• Auto Fishing with rod and bait selection.
• FPS Boost and visual customization.
• Anti-AFK, Auto Reconnect and server tools.
